declaration.policy: reference configuration 27; BF16 storage, FP32 reductions
declaration.identity: bounded exact namespace, salt and full token-prefix equality; no digest surrogate
declaration.timing_boundary: resident weights and ten warmup steps outside episode; retain seed, handoff, measured trace and final cache clear as separate host intervals

definitions.primary_arms: Four blocks per arm, excluding calibration self-controls; all twelve native calls per cell remain in the raw record.
definitions.comparisons: Exact original helper comparisons: enabled/disabled ratio within each block, median of four ratios; calibration determines noise floor and speed verdict.
definitions.displayed_medians: Median of four primary per-run statistics. TTFT and gap quantiles are medians of per-run quantiles, not quantiles of pooled requests.
definitions.gaps: Consecutive delivered token timestamps within each request; TTFT excluded. Maximum is computed from raw native delivery events.
definitions.duration_ns: Host phase-relative measure drain clock, including trace emission; excludes seeded preparation and final explicit cache clear.
definitions.episode_ns: Absolute host seed-begin to measure-end; includes seed and handoff, excludes ten-step warmup and final clear.
definitions.through_clear_ns: Descriptive only: absolute clear-end minus seed-begin, including the measure-to-clear gap and explicit cleanup. No new speed verdict.
definitions.seed_rows: Same cache-enabled seed in every arm; controls discard its index during handoff before measurement.
definitions.evictions: Removed index entries during measurement only; explicit handoff/final-clear removals counted separately.
definitions.admission_ns: Combined cache attach/reserve/evict/touch interval; not pure eviction time.
definitions.scope: One frozen bounded offline matrix on the qualified reference27 synchronous path; no capacity, SLO, async, Fast, or default-promotion claim.
